run_PanopticDeepLab_training: run the Panoptic-DeepLab training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
build_sem_seg_train_aug: build semantic segmentation training augmentations including resize, random crop, and random flip from config
build_Trainer_evaluator: build a COCO or Cityscapes panoptic evaluator for a given dataset name and output folder
build_Trainer_train_loader: build a training data loader using PanopticDeeplabDatasetMapper with configured augmentations
build_Trainer_optimizer: build an SGD or Adam optimizer with configurable weight decay and gradient clipping from config
